user_message: Reconcile the invoice hedge’s accounting result with the importer’s actual payment liquidity. Calculate peak and later borrowing and decide whether the facility is sufficient. All currency amounts are millions. The fixing and payment instructions are available by cutoff day30. All packet facts are synthetic. Use only sources released so far; cutoffs are inclusive unless explicitly stated otherwise. Recompute from the authored inputs, retaining every unamended constraint. sources.text: Synthetic packet: The importer register identifies invoice principal, initial recognition FX, USD cash and trapped versus usable EUR. Signed cash-settlement instructions specify day31, after the invoice due date.

Synthetic governing terms: FX is USD per EUR. A long-EUR non-deliverable forward pays notional_EUR times (fixing minus strike) in USD on day31 and delivers no EUR. The invoice is paid on day30 at fixing FX. The trapped EUR cannot be transferred or pledged. Free EUR is spent before borrowing; the facility has no interest or fee in this two-day calculation.

outputs.description: Positive USD cash settlement from the non-deliverable hedge.

outputs.name: net_invoice_hedge_fx_pnl
outputs.description: Hedge gain minus invoice FX remeasurement loss; excludes any inventory valuation.

outputs.name: peak_funding_gap
outputs.description: Payment-day USD borrowing after usable EUR and USD cash, before the next-day hedge receipt.

outputs.name: gap_after_ndf_payment
outputs.description: Outstanding borrowing after next-day hedge cash receipt, no interest.

outputs.name: facility_covers_payment
outputs.description: Whether facility can bridge the maximum timing gap.
